identificationModule.briefTitle: Nedaplatin/Docetaxel Versus Cisplatin/Docetaxel in Treatment of Advanced/Relapsed Squamous Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Nedaplatin/Docetaxel Versus Cisplatin/Docetaxel in Treatment of Advanced/Relapsed Squamous Cell Lung Cancer :A Randomized, Open, Parallel, Multicentre, Phase Ⅲ Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To compare the efficacy and safety of docetaxel plus nedaplatin with docetaxel plus cisplatin in managment of advanced/relapsed squamous cell lung cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This study is prospective to evaluate whether the efficacy and safety of docetaxel plus nedaplatin is non-inferior to docetaxel plus cisplatin in managment of advanced/relapsed squamous cell lung cancer.

armGroups.label: Docetaxel plus Nedaplatin
armGroups.description: docetaxel 60mg/m2 and nedaplatin 80mg/m2, d1 every 3 weeks

armGroups.label: Docetaxel plus Cisplatin
armGroups.description: docetaxel 60mg/m2 and cisplatin 75mg/m2, d1 every 3 weeks

locations.facility: Guangdong Lung Cancer Institute, Guangdong General Hospital, Guangdong Academy of Medical Sciences
